issues.issue: Fire Fund 'Local Receipts: Other' 119,683 is about 59% of all governmental receipts and has no breakdown anywhere in the report (it could be rural fire district payments, donations, insurance or loan proceeds). It is recorded as other with a review note, but decision_needed[] has no entry for it.

The capital outlay function comes from the fund column (Fire -> Public Safety; also Street -> Streets/Highways in disbursements[3] and Water -> Utilities in disbursements[7]). The 2026-11-12 FY2022 ruling allows a function only when it is printed. The fund-column rule was made for FY2023 (2026-11-13), so applying it to FY2022 is the extractor's assumption. The same applies to detail[16], detail[20] and detail[28].
